findings.evidence: Lines 102–123 use only `Module.Finite`, projections, and `Matrix.entryLinearMap`; lines 142–149 use only finrank formulas; lines 228–254 use those results and natural-number inequalities. Mathlib algebra APIs conventionally accept `[Semiring A] [Algebra K A]`, and TauCeti already does so at `Algebra/Subalgebra/Center.lean:112`.
findings.fix: State the presentation-based declarations with `[Semiring A] [Algebra K A]` and `[∀ i, Semiring (D i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (D i)]`; retain `Ring A` only for the Artin–Wedderburn existence section where `IsSemisimpleRing` requires it.
findings.issue: The global `[Ring A]` and the `[Ring (D i)]` assumptions in `Blocks`, `Coefficients`, and `Bounds` are stronger than required; these declarations only use algebra/module, matrix, and linear-equivalence structure.

summary: The presentation-based dimension and bound APIs impose unnecessary ring structures on the presented algebra and coefficient algebras.
